content: {"skill": "async (b) => { const items = await b.items(); const count = (name) => { let n = 0; for (const it of items) if (it.name && it.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()) n += (it.stack || 1); return n; }; const need = (name, qty) => count(name) < qty; const targets = [['Wood',3],['Stone',2]]; for (const [name, qty] of targets) { let guard = 0; while (count(name) < qty && guard < 20) { guard++; const obs = await b.observe(); const re = new RegExp(name + ' \\\\(material\\\\) at \\\\((\\\\d+),(\\\\d+)\\\\)', 'i'); const m = obs.match(re); if (!m) { b.log('no ' + name + ' found'); break; } const x = parseInt(m[1],10), y = parseInt(m[2],10); const r = await b.walkTo(x, y, 'adjacent'); if (!r || !r.ok) { b.log('walk fail ' + name + ': ' + JSON.stringify(r)); break; } const p = await b.faceAndPress(x, y, 'KeyE'); b.log('pick ' + name + ': ' + JSON.stringify(p)); await b.wait(200); } } if (need('Wood',3) || need('Stone',2)) { b.log('missing materials: wood=' + count('Wood') + ' stone=' + count('Stone')); return false; } const w = await b.workTile(6, 2, 0, 'KeyC'); b.log('craft: ' + JSON.stringify(w)); await b.wait(500); const o = await b.observe(); return /Crown/i.test(o); }", "check": "async (b) => { const o = await b.observe(); const ok = /Crown/i.test(o); return {ok, detail: ok ? 'Crown present' : 'No Crown found'}; }"}
